verdict.rationale: jo's docs say you can give it a job and a schedule (weekly plan, morning priorities, weekend review) that runs without asking each time. Because it has its own always-available cloud machine, it can work overnight, reading what came in and preparing your morning. That covers the core of scheduled, autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring and managing automations (trigger types, editing or pausing jobs, run logs or failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably.
